messages:
maya: Starting a staged rollout for rwd-infer service -> v2.3.1 at 20% (EU + US). Change window ends 21:00 UTC. Watchlist: eu-west 5xx, embedding regressions, p95 latency. Stop conditions: eu 5xx > 0.7% sustained for 5m OR p95 +100ms sustained for 5m. Please ack and monitor.

deploy-bot: [automated] kickoff job_id=job-4756 target=20% version=v2.3.1 regions=[eu,us]
Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/rollouts/job-4756
Actions: abort -> /deploy abort job-4756 | pause -> /deploy pause job-4756 | resume -> /deploy resume job-4756 | rollback -> /deploy rollback job-4756 --to v2.3.0

chris: noticed eu-west 500s ticked to 0.6% in the last 2m, tokenizer WARNs in logs (tokenizer v2.0.4). digging traces to confirm root cause.

ada: will tail the traces and error logs. If it stays below 0.7% for 5m we can proceed, otherwise hold and prepare rollback.

maya: holding additional ramp for now. Pausing further traffic expansion. @deploy-bot pause job-4756.

deploy-bot: job-4756 paused by maya (manual hold). Traffic locked at 20%. To rollback: /deploy rollback job-4756 --to v2.3.0

sre-team: telemetry check: p95 +40ms vs baseline, CPU/gpu within normal. Error budget burn low but tokenizer warnings align with small spike. Noncritical; good to hold and observe.

chris: opened PR to pin tokenizer for canary cohorts: https://git.redwood/infer/PR-1423 "pin tokenizer->v1.9 for canary cohorts". PR includes test checklist and rollback ops steps.

maya: good. Adding ops note in release notes to call out tokenizer fallback and rollback instructions.

ops-bot: Release notes updated: "v2.3.1: staged rollout includes fallback tokenizer strategy; if eu 5xx >0.7% for 5m, rollback to v2.3.0 and pin tokenizer to v1.9 for canary". Link: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/v2.3.1

maya: we'll hold for 10m then reassess. If eu 5xx breaches threshold or p95 > +100ms for 5m, we rollback. Acks?

ada: ack — monitoring dashboards and alerts.

chris: ack — on-call to merge PR and execute rollback if needed. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: snapshot: eu 5xx=0.59%, us 5xx=0.03%, p95 delta=+38ms. Paused. Waiting for manual resume/rollback.

maya: thanks all. Calling for end-of-hold at +10m for go/no-go decision.
